title: Normalized finite matrix cokernels and coordinate quotients after constant realization
statement: Let R, (C,J), B and σ be as in [lem-per-constant-scalar-cokernel]. Let D:R^m→R^n be a finite rectangular matrix, p:R^n→V an ordinary module map, and a0:V≅coker D an isomorphism satisfying p followed by a0 equals the cokernel projection. There are dB:B^m→B^n, pB:B^n→E_B(V), and w:E_B(V)≅coker dB, with pB followed by w equal to the projection. The coordinates of dB are the constant images of the entries of D; every original vector x has its constant-coordinate lift y satisfying pB(y)=1 tensor p(x). For any r, coordinate selector t:Fin r→Fin n, P∈GL_n(R), Q∈GL_m(R), and a:coker D≅R^r whose quotient projection sends x to (Px) restricted along t, there are automorphisms p_prime of B^n and q_prime of B^m with coordinates P,Q and inverse coordinates P inverse,Q inverse, and b:coker dB≅B^r such that the new quotient projection has coordinates t of p_prime. Finite powers and normalization use [lem-sfb-constant-finite-free-presentation-extension].

proof.text: Conjugate realization of D by the canonical normalized beta comparisons. Its coordinate formula is matrixMap_apply and the ordinary basis vector calculation.

Realization preserves the cokernel, so transport a0 and its quotient equation to obtain w. The beta tensor formula and naturality on constant generators supply the constant-vector lift and quotient formula.

Realize the supplied invertible row and column matrices and their inverses. Functoriality transports the ordinary quotient equation to sheaves; matrixMap_apply for coordinate selection gives the claimed coordinate quotient.

Found ModuleCat.isColimitCokernelCofork and PreservesCokernel.iso with its projection equation. These are used to construct the normalized comparisons; neither supplies the coefficientwise finite-power normalization or the rank-tail computation.

Read Mathlib ModuleCat/Kernels, ChangeOfRings, TensorProduct/Pi, Matrix/ToLin, Limits/Preserves/Shapes/Kernels. No duplicate of these normalized helpers.
